items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: He still let it play with him that night and we had a double band... They said come on Biffley, we call him Biffley. I said come on baby, we got a job tonight man.

ctx.x: He still let it play with him that night and we had a double band. So me and John Joseph was on the bass and everything, so he said, Bill can you get another clarinet big band's coming back. I said sure, I can get red. They said come on Biffley, we call him Biffley. I said come on baby, we got a job tonight man. He said well, we're going to play against Kid Ora and them. Kid Ora and Oliver back at Me and Willa. Who was the trumpet?
